text:
**First response — Issue #30 (peer-range bump to admit bareguard 0.13.x)**

Status: already closed as completed (Aug 13) — this is triage only; do not reopen or file a duplicate.

- Confirm nothing is outstanding: bare-agent v0.36.1 is published to npm as latest; PR #31 merged; tag v0.36.1.
- Spot-check the manifest on the registry: peer + dev range should read `>=0.9.0 <0.14.0`. If it still shows `<0.13.0`, escalate to hamr0.
- No code change was ever needed — `judgeToAnnotation` (src/bareguard-adapter.js) already sets an explicit-boolean `surface`, so it satisfied bareguard 0.13.0's stricter annotate rule by construction.
- Evidence if challenged: bareguard-touching tests 84/84 against bareguard 0.13.0; CI full suite green.
- User reporting an install-time peer conflict: have them upgrade to 0.36.1. Nothing else to change.
